title: Derived Object Classification Provenance Foundation
objective: Preserve validated source-classification provenance directly on derived object references so derived knowledge retains an explicit, durable, and verifiable relationship to the classifications from which it was produced.
scope: Extend DerivedObjectReference with direct source classification identifiers.
Propagate validated sourceClassificationIds from derivation requests into generated derived object references.
Preserve classification provenance through pipeline-generated derived objects.
Fail closed during durable retrieval when derived-object classification provenance is inconsistent with the persisted classification and transformation lineage.
Add focused derivation, pipeline, persistence, and retrieval regression coverage.
nonGoals: Changes to ingestion, extraction, segmentation, or classification behavior.
Changes to production retrieval service authority beyond consuming the strengthened persisted contract.
authority: Derivation remains responsible for constructing derived object references from validated derivation requests.
Persistence retrieval remains authoritative for validation of durable generated-record structure and cross-record identity/provenance.
No duplicate production-service validation is introduced.
